sources.description: In general, the Denver Broncos have focused on lighter athletic OTs recently, although the Broncos still have not drafted an OT since selecting Garett Bolles in the 2017 draft. There are a number of lighter athletic OTs that will be available in the mid-to-late rounds in the draft this year, should the Broncos finally decide […]
